A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Human''' was the first wife of [[Huff Darklighter]] and the mother of [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]].<ref name="BW" />

She [[Death/Legends|died]] before the birth of [[Gavin Darklighter]].<ref name="BW" />
